newsitem.title: UK: Virgin set to launch internet service in November.
newsitem.headline: Virgin set to launch internet service in November.

text.p: Richard Branson's Virgin Group is set to launch an Internet service in November in a joint venture with US cable firm International CableTel Inc.

A Virgin company spokesman told Reuters, "We are going to offer a very consumer focused Internet service. We think there are an awful lot of people out there who have got PCs but there are not that many at home who use the internet."
He said the official launch of the service, to be known as Virgin Net, and details of the service would be announced in early November.
Virgin Net is 51 percent owned by Virgin Communications with the remainder held by CableTel.
RM Plc, which supplies information technology solutions to educational markets, said earlier Monday it had agreed with Virgin Net to provide an education service to home users via the Internet.
